implementation_scope: Resource lifecycle coordinator; not durable command admission, authority or qualification of concrete hosts
in_flight_limit: Required nonzero u16, fixed per session; shared by every cloned handle
startup: Repeat/resume a partially completed host start; admission only after success; closing interrupts pending startup and cannot reopen
cancellation: Retain successful stages; resume only the unfinished hook. Hosts retain hook progress and obtained results across cancellation or failure
permit_ownership: Executor retains permit through its safe journal boundary independently of caller observation; permit retains session resources and is not a durable receipt
waker_callbacks_and_destructors: Run outside the synchronous admission gate, including replacement, clearing and wake
remaining_qualification: Concrete native and browser resource hosts
Owned durable command workers and result retention
